Tom / Orion legal team — thanks for the details and the profile. Per our internal review, we're attaching a first-pass set of redlines to highlight the material points so the negotiation can focus on the few open items. Summary of our position (high-level):

1) Liability & cap: propose to keep mutual liability cap at the greater of $1M or 12 months of fees; request Orion confirm whether procurement requires a higher cap and provide data to justify.
2) Data retention / audit logs: we can accept a defined retention window for customer-provided data and security logs, but need clarity on scope — suggest limiting audit access to security/compliance-related personnel and using a formal request process.
3) KMS / encryption: Redwood can support customer-managed keys for encrypted data in flight/halted storage in private deployment; for hosted accounts we offer encrypted-at-rest with managed KMS by default. If Orion requires a specific KMS integration, we'll need an ops design discussion.
4) SOC 2: we can provide our SOC 2 Type II report under NDA; production onboarding will require that evidence.
5) Payment & invoicing (Order Form): request net-30 standard; if Orion requires PO terms, we can accept POs so long as the order references the signed Order Form.

Next steps: we've attached a marked-up MSA (Orion_MSA_v1_redlines.pdf) with tracked comments. If Orion can return a marked-up version of our Order Form or list specific order-level changes, we can incorporate them and aim to close commercial terms within 1–2 weeks.

Propose a 30-min legal sync tomorrow (Fri 6/6) 09:00 PT to go over the marked redlines. If that doesn't work, share 2 alternative windows.

Attachments: Orion_MSA_v1_redlines.pdf

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
